name: Acceding Titans
description: Acceding Titans is a business directory and community for African entrepreneurs — a verified directory of businesses, and a member network where people in the same trade and area refer work, ask for help and share opportunities.

offers.name: USD Accounts
offers.description: Receive, hold, and manage US Dollar payments conveniently from clients, businesses, and international platforms.

offers.name: Virtual Dollar Cards
offers.description: Secure virtual USD cards for international online payments, subscriptions, advertising, e-commerce, and global transactions.

offers.name: Wallet Transfers
offers.description: Fast and secure transfers between Acceding Titans users.

offers.name: Bank Transfers
offers.description: Send funds seamlessly to local and external bank accounts.

offers.name: Business Directory
offers.description: A verified directory of African entrepreneurs and businesses, searchable by trade, service and location.

offers.name: Member Network
offers.description: Members connect with others in their trade and area to trade referrals, ask for help and share opportunities.
